items.title: AfroCan Roots & Rhythms Festival 2026
items.summary: Celebrate the richness and diversity of African and Caribbean culture at this vibrant, high-energy festival. From powerful live performances to music that moves you, this is a full-sensory experience rooted in heritage, community, and expression. Expect live music, cultural showcases, dynamic dance performances, and a lineup of artists bringing the sounds of Afrobeats, reggae, dancehall, and more to life. Explore authentic cuisine, support local vendors, and connect with a community that celebrates culture in every form.

items.title: International Observe the Moon Night
items.summary: International Observe the Moon Night is a worldwide public event that encourages observation, appreciation and understanding of our Moon.

items.title: Butter Tarts & More Market
items.summary: The Streetsville Butter Tarts & More Market, presented by Gotta Luv Buttertarts, will take place on Saturday, September 19, 2026. The event will showcase a delicious assortment of sweet treats, fresh baked goods, and a wide variety of butter tarts from local and small businesses. Visitors can shop from local vendors, discover unique products, and enjoy live performances by local musicians throughout the day.

items.title: Taste of Cooksville 2026
items.summary: Two days of global flavours, live entertainment and family fun await at one of Mississauga’s largest food festivals! Cooksville BIA presents Taste of Cooksville 2026, a free celebration of food, music, culture, local shopping and so much more. This year, enjoy extended festival hours, explore the Cooksville community, and check out a brand-new car show featuring an exciting lineup of vehicles.

items.title: Portugalo Fest 2026
items.summary: Celebrate the vibrant traditions, culture, and community spirit of Portugal at Portugalo Fest 2026 in Mississauga. This exciting annual festival brings together residents and visitors for a memorable celebration of Portuguese heritage, featuring live entertainment, traditional music and dance performances, authentic cuisine, cultural exhibits, local artisans, and activities for all ages.

items.title: The 3rd Annual of Arts of the Middle East Festival
items.summary: The Arts of the Middle East Festival celebrates the diverse cultures, traditions, and artistic expressions of the Middle East through a full day of performances, cultural experiences, family activities, and food. The festival features live performances by talented Arabic artists, showcasing music, dance, and cultural traditions from across the region. A dedicated children's area offers interactive activities and entertainment for younger attendees.
